representation_note: 3D model drawn from published catalog and literature values (each fact shows its source) - not an image. Sizes and distances may be exaggerated for visibility.

notes: Values checked on 2026-11-14 against the NASA Exoplanet Archive, SIMBAD (CfA mirror), Gaia DR3, VizieR and the cited papers (tasks/WS7-3d-systems.md, WS7-2). Facts still marked 'unverified' are estimates no source states.
The challenge gives 133.79513, −7.24515: the WISE All-Sky position at epoch 2010.34 (MJD 55320.4). The object moves ~8.2 arcsec per year, so positions must be propagated to the date of each image.
The model is drawn with 5 Jupiter masses, an illustrative value inside the published 3–10 range.
